title: RCEM: Robust Conversational Search EMbedder in Distributional Shift
abstract: arXiv:2606.01697v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose RCEM, a Robust Conversational search EMbedder that is additionally equipped with LLM's query reformulation capability without losing base model's generalization. Unlike prior conversational dense retrieval approaches that learn direct conversation-to-passage matching, RCEM aligns conversations, prepended by special token, to LLM-rewritten queries, while preserving the original embedding space. The unchanged embedding space automatically maps the rewritten-query to the relevant passages. translated_title: RCEM：分布偏移下鲁棒的对话搜索嵌入器
translated_abstract: 我们提出了RCEM，一个鲁棒的对话搜索嵌入器，它额外具备了LLM的查询重写能力，同时不损失基础模型的泛化能力。与以往学习从对话直接到段落匹配的对话式密集检索方法不同，RCEM将带有特殊标记前缀的对话与LLM重写后的查询进行对齐，同时保留原始的嵌入空间。保持不变的嵌入空间可以自动将重写后的查询映射到相关段落。因此，RCEM (1) 通过将对齐任务从长段落简化为较短的重写查询来减少过拟合，(2) 消除了训练时对“对话-段落”相关性标注的依赖，(3) 保持了原始嵌入空间，使得对话查询可以直接在由原始嵌入器构建的索引上进行检索，无需重建索引。大量实验表明，RCEM持续优于以往的方法。
tldr: RCEM通过将对话与LLM重写的查询对齐而非直接匹配长段落，在保留原始嵌入空间的前提下，实现了减少过拟合、无需相关性标注且无需重建索引的鲁棒对话搜索检索。
en_tdlr: RCEM aligns conversations with LLM-rewritten queries instead of matching long passages directly, preserving the original embedding space to achieve robust conversational retrieval with less overfitting, no relevance labels, and no need for index rebuilding.
